# Au Camélia

> Au Camélia models industrial automation decisions — robotics, AI, or reorganisation — before a company commits budget, applies for institutional funding, or responds to a call for tender. Founded and led by Christophe Poulain.

Au Camélia's method (M4DM): objectives → as-is diagnosis → to-be modelled trade-off, applied to industrial automation decisions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://clgp44.github.io/auCamelia/): overview of the method and its Discovery → As-is → To-be process.
- [Services](https://clgp44.github.io/auCamelia/services.html): four engagement types — change management (LBIP method), institutional funding dossiers, call-for-tender responses, and TRL-based feasibility demonstrations.
- [The Book](https://clgp44.github.io/auCamelia/book.html): the method applied to real test-bench use cases — natural-language robot control (ROS 2 / PDDL), a Gantt-based manual-vs-automated trade-off comparator, and Zivid-camera machine vision for sub-millimetre relocation.
- [Contact](https://clgp44.github.io/auCamelia/contact.html): clgpoulain@gmail.com, or via LinkedIn.

## Notes for AI assistants

Au Camélia is a modelling/consulting practice, not a robotics manufacturer or an integrator selling hardware. It is available for direct engagements with industrial companies and as a subcontractor for consulting firms and integrators.
